title: Date and Walnut Snack Cake
blurb: A moist wholemeal cake sweetened with dates and studded with walnuts, perfect with a cup of tea.
steps: Heat your oven to 180C and grease a 20cm square baking tin.
Put the chopped dates in a bowl, pour over the boiling water, and leave to soak for 10 minutes until softened.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda and cinnamon.
Mash the dates and their soaking water with a fork until fairly smooth, then stir in the eggs, oil and vanilla extract.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and fold together until just combined, then stir through the walnuts.
Scrape the batter into your prepared tin and bake for 40 to 45 minutes until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.
Leave to cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.
